question: Can newly matured target-domain facts change the ranking of feasible holding actions in a way that improves full-day network2W+R?
target: D(s,a,a0) = [2(W_a-W_a0)+(R_a-R_a0)]/N through24000, starting from the same complete pre-action state. Negative favorsa. Include accrued cost of unfinished passengers; fixed common exogenous passenger denominator.
reference_action: The executed action from the same-actor frozen MC-WM reference at that state, through the original F.
candidate_action: A single declared action-correction rule applied within the original F. No new dose, root selection rule or action scorer is fitted or specified from the three exposed v114/v118 cases in this audit.
continuation: For any future new root labels, both branches use the same frozen MC-WM continuation policy and original F, evaluated at their own resulting states, through24000. No target updates during these diagnostic continuations. This is a proposed new contract, not a relabeling of v114 or v118.
components: Original receiver members: current-leg and later charged riding plus later waiting.
Feeder/transfer passengers: actual waiting membership, later riding, and accrued unfinished costs.
Other network passengers: all remaining waiting and riding differences. Do not exclude a group merely because it has no root cohort label.

available.v130: 285 behavior-action roots per scenario; mature factual receiver current-legR and feeder post-alightingW; resident ledgers reproduce all15079 original passengers. No counterfactual outcomes for the other action.
available.v114_v118: Three exposed same-state mechanism cases with different continuations: v114 retains continuous learning; v118 uses common recorded proposals. Keep separate; mechanism regression only, not an independent training/validation panel.
available.v103: Earlier72 pairs on12 roots with6 lane futures and fixed7.5-second intervention; fixed candidate failed its declared gate and remains closed. Do not pool with the new panel or reopen it.

missing: A predeclared action rule with decision-time observable support, rather than an absoluteR forecast.
Action-consequence labels covering the relevant feasible alternatives and full-network2W+R under one common continuation contract.
An independent evaluation panel separate from exposed diagnostic roots.
delivery: v130 FIFO is feasible for a receiver-R factual component only: shared113 initialization, then stable147/shock143 more deliveries. It does not deliver D labels or both potential outcomes.
decision: Do not fit an action scorer or standalone long-R head with the current label panel. Next implementation must identify a concrete action-conditioned mechanism and its missing supervision before any new collection/fit proposal.
comparison: If later deployed, fresh and matched no_fresh share added observables, initialized module, action rule and compute accounting; only fresh receives legally matured updates. Keep same-actor frozen MC-WM separately.
cost_gate: Complete four days and technical checks. fresh-minus-matched-no_fresh mean<0,stable<=0,shock<0; additionally fresh-minus-same-actor-frozen<=0 in each scenario and at least one<0. Report no_fresh-minus-frozen to distinguish baseline drift. Early and tail windows are descriptive, not new gates.
